# Copilot defaults for this repository

- Use the custom agents in `.github/agents/` and skills in `.github/skills/` when they match the task.
- Make small, targeted changes; run the relevant build or tests to verify them.
- Python/Jupyter: dependencies are in `requirements.txt`.
- Swift (`MathTutorMac/`): requires Swift 5.5+ (async/await, `@MainActor`).
